tagline: Plan the trip, keep the days, the spending and the packing in one place
heroTitle: A trip plan that fits in your pocket
heroSub: Pick a destination, build day by day plans, track expenses and pack without forgetting anything. Your plans are saved on this device.
noTrips: No trips yet. Create your first trip to start planning.
selectTrip: Select a trip to see its plan
deleteConfirm: Delete this trip and all its days, expenses and packing items?
dayTitlePh: Example: Old Cairo and the museum
dayEmpty: No days yet. Add the first day of this trip.
activityPh: Add an activity, example: visit the Egyptian Museum at 9am
notePh: Write a note about this trip
mapNote: No map service is connected, so this plan uses a list view instead of a live map. Add a map API key later to show destinations on a map.
footerNote: Demo planner. Trips are saved in your browser localStorage. Sample destinations are labelled sample.
formError: Please fill in the trip name, destination and both dates. The end date must be after the start date.
